screenshots.title: Measurement takeoff
screenshots.alt: GridScalr showing a calibrated industrial floor plan with warehouse, office and workshop measurements and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: A calibrated industrial takeoff with rectangle areas, counts, a deduction and drawing annotations.

screenshots.title: Default (medium gray) theme
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the medium gray interface theme, a calibrated industrial floor plan and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: The default neutral mid-gray theme with the jade accent.

screenshots.title: Light theme
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the light interface theme, a calibrated industrial floor plan and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: A cool light theme with white panels for bright rooms.

screenshots.title: Dark Gray theme
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the dark gray interface theme, a calibrated industrial floor plan and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: Low-chroma dark chrome with the jade accent.

screenshots.title: Dark Jade theme
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the original dark jade interface theme, a calibrated industrial floor plan and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: The original dark palette with the jade accent.

screenshots.title: Navy theme
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the navy interface theme, a calibrated industrial floor plan and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: Blue-shifted dark chrome with the jade accent.

screenshots.title: Measure and annotate
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the Length tool active, the Layers panel open and a compact New measurement summary in the context bar, with Properties on the right.
screenshots.description: Measurement and drawing tools share one canvas but stay on separate layer types.

screenshots.title: Measurement flyout
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr measurement flyout with category, room, area shape, area mode and target layer beside the active Area tool.
screenshots.description: One flyout owns the New measurement settings and the page-scoped target layer.

screenshots.title: Calibration
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Edit calibration dialog for page 1, showing a 10 m reference length, a unit selector, and the option to update existing measurements while the calibration line stays visible on the plan.
screenshots.description: Calibrate a page against a known dimension or enter a printed scale, then lock it against accidental changes.

screenshots.title: Markups and layers
screenshots.alt: GridScalr Layers panel with a revision cloud around a loading dock, a callout at the entrance and an inspected stamp.
screenshots.description: Revision clouds, callouts and status stamps live on drawing layers.

screenshots.title: Expanded layer items
screenshots.alt: GridScalr Layers panel with page-scoped layers, a measurement layer expanded to show items on the current page, and the Add/Deduct switch in the context bar.
screenshots.description: Expand a layer to inspect every item, select it on the plan and choose additive or deduction areas.

screenshots.title: Layers in the light theme
screenshots.alt: GridScalr Layers panel in the Light Green theme with the drawing layer section, the expanded measurement layer section and its footer actions on a light inset surface.
screenshots.description: Layer sections follow every palette; the light theme uses its own inset instead of a dark surface.

screenshots.title: Operation card sheet
screenshots.alt: GridScalr showing an A3 operation card sheet with schematic symbols for heat exchanger, fans, valves and dampers, the drawing layers and the sheet title block.
screenshots.description: Draw operation cards with the schematic symbol library, sheet templates and page-scoped layers.

screenshots.title: Order
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Order dialog showing gross, deduction, net, waste and order quantities by category and room.
screenshots.description: Live order quantities with deductions, waste and rounding for procurement.

screenshots.title: Takeoff settings — Objects
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Takeoff settings Objects tab with measured categories and counted types in one list with a Type column, including a custom Socket type and its glyph picker.
screenshots.description: Measured and counted objects share one list, and each counted object chooses the vector glyph used on the plan and in exports.

screenshots.title: Count schedule
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Markups table grouped by count type with the Count type column visible and count rows for doors, windows and fixtures.
screenshots.description: Group the Markups table by count type to review a door, window or fixture schedule without custom columns.

screenshots.title: Markups list
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Markups panel with a saved Room review view, building, floor and room groups, and the Name, Type, Page, Layer, Value, Category and Room columns.
screenshots.description: A docked, project-wide list with saved views, configurable columns, grouping, filters, and row navigation.

screenshots.title: Symbol library
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr symbol library opened from the tool rail, with searchable fire, evacuation, HVAC, electrical, building and waste symbols, a selected extinguisher on the plan and Markups grouped by symbol category and status.
screenshots.description: Place vector facility symbols with category colours, rotation and inspection status, then review them in the Markups list.

screenshots.title: Embedded images
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr plan with an embedded inspection photo of a loading dock selected, showing image handles and the Properties panel with image mode, opacity and rotation controls.
screenshots.description: Embed PNG or JPEG photos in a project, place them above the PDF or below markups, and adjust size, rotation and opacity.

screenshots.title: Drawing export
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Drawing PDF export dialog with page range, crop area, layer selection, labels and legend options.
screenshots.description: Export visible markups as a flattened drawing PDF without modifying the source drawing.

screenshots.title: Project package
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Package project dialog with optional quantity exports, drawing PDF and original TIF scans switched off, and a note that packages require the desktop app in the browser fallback.
screenshots.description: Package the project and its drawings as a standard ZIP with a manifest and checksums; reports and original scans stay opt-in.

screenshots.title: Reference view
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with a primary editable canvas and a read-only reference pane showing the same calibrated floor plan at the same pan and zoom, with a source selector for Same page, Revision and Drawing.
screenshots.description: A read-only reference pane follows the primary canvas while keeping edits, selection and undo in one place. Switch its source between the same page, a saved revision or a raw PDF drawing.

screenshots.title: Revision or drawing comparison
screenshots.alt: GridScalr comparing the current takeoff with a reference revision in overlay mode, with a differences panel showing changed, added and removed items.
screenshots.description: Load a reference revision without merging it, switch between side-by-side and overlay, and export a comparison PDF. A raw PDF drawing reference keeps the visuals and export without a markup diff.

screenshots.title: Full-text search
screenshots.alt: GridScalr search panel with a text query, page results and a highlighted match on the drawing.
screenshots.description: Search the PDF text layer across every page and jump to a highlighted result.

screenshots.title: Workflows in the help dialog
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Help dialog open on the Workflows tab with guides for operations technicians and technical property managers.
screenshots.description: Task-oriented workflows sit beside the full user guide, shortcuts and About.

screenshots.title: Preferences — Data
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Preferences dialog on the Data category with autosave controls, rolling backup retention, the recovery center action and the recent-file list.
screenshots.description: Autosave, rolling backups and recovery records are app-level preferences stored on this computer, never in the project file.

screenshots.title: Recovery center
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Recovery center listing stored autosaves and checkpoints with their time, size, project and base-version state.
screenshots.description: One dialog for every local autosave and structural checkpoint, with explicit restore and delete.

screenshots.title: Project status popover
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr project status popover with the last save and backup state, autosave interval, validation warnings, the recovery record and the backup, recovery, doctor and conflicted-copy actions.
screenshots.description: The saved/unsaved chip opens a live summary with backup, recovery, doctor and conflicted-copy actions.

screenshots.title: Custom fields
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Custom fields dialog with measurement-scope Fire class and Condition fields, a typed value editor and a Fire data field set.
screenshots.description: Define typed property data once, then fill it in for each measurement from Properties.

screenshots.title: Takeoff settings — Fields
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Takeoff settings Fields tab listing the measurement and space fields with their applies-to rules and the field sets, with the Manage fields action.
screenshots.description: Fields and field sets live in the Takeoff settings hub; the editor and its rules are the same one the inspector uses.

screenshots.title: Custom field values in Properties
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Properties panel for a selected floor area with the Fields section showing a Fire class text value and a Condition choice, plus the field-set action.
screenshots.description: Fields are filled on the selected measurement with the control that matches the field type.

screenshots.title: Space register
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Spaces dialog with a building, a floor and two rooms, a measured area badge and a manual area badge.
screenshots.description: Buildings, floors, rooms and zones keep their area derived from the area measurements linked to them.

screenshots.title: Takeoff tab
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Takeoff tab with Rooms, Area, Walls and Doors cards, a takeoff table picker showing Room schedule, page and space filters, and a live table of rooms.
screenshots.description: Four live KPI cards and a takeoff table in the right dock, computed from the project data.

screenshots.title: Takeoff preview without a table
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Takeoff tab with the four KPI cards and the labelled Preview – cannot be placed state, offering Create takeoff table and Create takeoff table and place….
screenshots.description: Opening the tab writes nothing. The standard takeoff table exists only after the explicit create action.

screenshots.title: Standard takeoff table
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Takeoff tab showing the Standard takeoff table with Object, Count, Unit and Value columns and one row per item.
screenshots.description: The standard table is an ordinary takeoff table: one row per item, created in one undo step and editable in the builder.

screenshots.title: Takeoff table builder
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr takeoff table builder with name, measurement source, columns, grouping, sorting, totals and filters.
screenshots.description: Choose columns, grouping, sorting, filters and totals while the preview uses the real takeoff table engine.

screenshots.title: Takeoff settings — Cards
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Takeoff settings Cards tab with the four cards, their visibility switches and the Fed by lists for Walls categories and Doors count types.
screenshots.description: A card reads the categories or count types ticked under Fed by, never a name.

screenshots.title: Takeoff settings — Tables
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Takeoff settings Tables tab listing the saved takeoff tables with Edit, Duplicate and Delete, and the New takeoff table action.
screenshots.description: Saved takeoff tables are managed in the hub, which never creates a table by opening.

screenshots.title: Takeoff table placed on a drawing
screenshots.alt: A takeoff table placed on a calibrated floor plan and selected, with its row range, header and totals in the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: A placed table is a live drawing item: it moves, resizes, locks, hides and exports with the page.

screenshots.title: Takeoff table CSV import
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Import takeoff table CSV dialog with a changed row, before and after values, unchanged rows and the apply action.
screenshots.description: A CSV from Excel is checked in a dry run before one confirmed import is applied as one undo step.
